notes: Draft configuration: The independently mapped long ICAR route retains the west hairpin, central rounded loop, northern triangular turn and full southern return with chicane. It excludes short-course diagonal and southern bypass alternatives. The operator identifies the full 3.4 km road circuit; NASCAR also distinguishes this historical full course from subsequent short race configurations. Its 3330.7 m exact source route remains unscaled against the 3386 m catalogue scalar. Chicane corner alignment and direction remain draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3330.7 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 63 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
